composition.value: Underlying composition is out of copyright where the ordinary life-plus-70 term applies.
composition.note: The composer died in 1943. This is a term calculation, not a worldwide clearance or a statement about an unidentified modern edition.

recording.value: Commons applies PD-EU-audio: expiry of European performers’ and phonogram producers’ rights.
recording.note: This is a territory-specific expiry claim, not CC0 or permission from the record company. The 70-year extension did not revive recordings whose earlier term had already expired by 1 November 2013. It does not establish public-domain status in the United States. The stated 1959 session is not by itself proof of first publication. The European expiry claim must not be presented as US public-domain status: § 1401 gives post-1956 recordings fixed before 15 February 1972 a term ending on 15 February 2067.
